## PS5Save+ v0.1.0-alpha.3

This alpha introduces multiple USB destinations and refreshes the PS5Save+ interface.

### New
- **Multiple USB drives:** detects writable external volumes mounted as `/mnt/usb0` through `/mnt/usb7`. On first launch, a drive with an existing backup is preferred; otherwise the drive with the most free space is selected.
- **Choose the backup USB:** select it in **Dashboard → Settings** after pairing with the PS5, or set `backup_usb_device=/mnt/usbN` in `backup.conf`. `auto` keeps automatic selection.
- **Transfer existing backups:** an explicit change copies `ps5save-plus/` (including configuration, live backups and snapshots) to a staged directory on the new USB, checks file contents byte-for-byte and switches only after a successful comparison. Existing destination folders are never overwritten; failures preserve the source.
- **New PS5Save+ artwork:** the user-supplied Plus icon is embedded for notifications and the home-screen shortcut. Existing owned shortcuts update their icon without reinstalling the title; PS5 ShellUI may cache the previous tile until refreshed.
- **Dashboard branding:** the PlayStation mark replaces the decorative `+` in the header.
- **Clear startup confirmation:** after a successful unchanged backup check, the console shows a localized “Backup up to date. No changes.” message. Running the ELF always triggers an immediate backup check and backs up changes when found.

### Important
- **Multi-USB transfers have passed host regression tests and PS5 SDK cross-compilation, but still require physical-console validation on firmware 11.60.** Test with expendable backup copies before moving your only backup.
- The previously reported ~10-second delay between a progress toast and completion has **not** been confirmed as fixed. The code sends the completion immediately, but PS5 ShellUI may defer its display.
- The backup destination is restricted to external USB mountpoints. The dashboard is available at `http://<PS5-IP>:8755/` on a trusted local network; do not expose that port publicly.

### Download
Launch **`ps5saveplus_v0.1.0-alpha.3.elf`** with your PS5 payload loader and an exFAT USB connected. Existing `backup.conf` settings remain valid; the new `backup_usb_device` setting is optional.

Based on [heni0xyz/PS5Save](https://github.com/heni0xyz/PS5Save). Licensed under GPL-3.0.
